profile.ja: 対魔忍。心願寺紅に長年付き従っている忠実なる従者。将来を嘱望されたエリート対魔忍だったが、紅に命を救われたことからその強さと優しさに心酔して自ら志願して紅の従者となる。“風読み”と呼ばれる異能を持ち、周囲の風の流れを察知して驚異的な精度での狙撃を可能にする他、高度な空間把握・状況認識を持つことで予知に近いレベルでの“先読み”ができるようになる。一見柔和なお姉さんと言った雰囲気だが、紅を守るためならどのような手段も厭わない苛烈な一面を持つ。“風読み”による空間把握により観測手（スポッター）を必要としない狙撃手であったが、紅を取り巻く情勢の変化によって、より広範囲の索敵、より高頻度での状況把握を求め、米連の技術を取り入れた高性能ライフルガンへと武器を新調した。新しい武器は、彼女が打ち上げた個人向け人工軌道衛星の識別型番『ＳＧＧ‐９０７１』が観測手の役割を果たし、高性能遠距離センサーによる解析データを常時銃身へと送信する仕組みを持っている。
profile.en: They are a Taimanin and a loyal attendant who has been serving Shinganji Kurenai for many years. They were once an elite Taimanin with a promising future, but after being saved by Kurenai, they became deeply devoted to her strength and kindness, and voluntarily became her attendant. They possess a unique ability called "wind reading," which allows them to detect the flow of wind around them and achieve incredible accuracy in their marksmanship. This ability also grants them advanced spatial awareness and situational recognition, enabling them to anticipate events with near-precognitive accuracy. Although they appear to be a gentle and soft-spoken older sister, they have a ruthless side when it comes to protecting Kurenai, and they will stop at nothing to defend her. As a sniper, they previously didn't require a spotter due to their "wind reading" ability, but with the changing circumstances surrounding Kurenai, they have acquired a new, high-performance rifle gun that incorporates technology from the US. This new weapon features a personally launched artificial satellite with the designation "SGG-9071," which serves as a spotter and constantly transmits analysis data from its high-performance long-distance sensors to the rifle.

text.ja: これまでの自分を超えなくちゃいけない時が来たわね。いつまでも、紅様を支えてゆけるように。そのためならどんな事だってするわ
text.en: It's time for me to surpass my current self. I need to be able to support Lady Kurenai at all times. I'll do whatever it takes to make that happen.

text.ja: 開けた場所の無防備な標的が相手なら、自宅でコーヒーを飲みながらでも撃ち抜けるわ。スナイパーもリモートワークの時代かしらね
text.en: If the target is out in the open and unguarded, I can take them out from anywhere - even while drinking coffee at home. I guess you could say sniping has entered the era of remote work.

text.ja: 私がこの武装のために購入した個人向け人工軌道衛星は特注のものよ。ええ、そうね、識別型番も私が直々に指定したわ。それが何か？
text.en: The personal artificial satellite I purchased for this armament is custom-made. Yes, that's right - I personally specified the designation. What is it, you ask?

text.ja: あなたの指揮だと、狙撃手の私を前線でも活用する事が多いわね。うふふ、分かってるわ。それだけ私の力量を評価しているのよね？
text.en: When you're in command, you often deploy me as a sniper on the front lines, don't you? Hehe, I know why - you appreciate my abilities, don't you?

text.ja: 言いたい事は分かるわ。私だって私以外の従者がこの力を手に入れたら同じように思うわね。だけど、誓って紅様を覗きはしてないわ
text.en: I understand what you're getting at. If another attendant were to acquire this power, I'd think the same way. But I swear I've never used my abilities to spy on Lady Kurenai.

text.ja: 今も私の“風読み”には絶対の自信があるわ。だけど、それじゃあ私の殻は破れない……だから米連からの技術供出を受け入れたの
text.en: I still have absolute confidence in my "wind reading" abilities. However, if I relied solely on that, I'd never be able to break through my limits... That's why I've accepted the technology provided by the US.

text.ja: 紅様の置かれた状況は、とても難しい状態……従者如きが過分な申し出だけれど……どうか手を差し伸べてあげてはくれないかしら
text.en: Lady Kurenai's situation is extremely difficult... It's presumptuous of me, a mere attendant, but... would you be willing to lend her a hand?

text.ja: どっちの道の方が空いてるか？　もう、この装備をカーナビ扱いしないで欲しいわね……まあ、調べてはあげるけれど
text.en: Which route is clearer? I wish you'd stop treating this equipment like a car navigation system... Fine, I'll check for you, but...

text.ja: あうぅうっ、く……捕らわれたスナイパーの末路というわけね……ああっ、ああっ！　くうぅ、紅様、申し訳ありません……
text.en: Uuuuh, k... This is the fate that awaits a captured sniper, I suppose... Ahh, ahh! I'm sorry, Lady Kurenai...

text.ja: はぁ、はあぁ……おおぉっ、きもちいいっ、きもちいいぃ……これまで狙撃した分、私の弱点に贖罪ザーメン打ち込んでぇっ！
text.en: Haa, haa... Ooh, it feels so good, it feels so good... It's as if the semen is atoning for all the times I've sniped at people...

text.ja: つ、次は、何をされるのかしら？　くぅっ……目も風読みも封じられて『視えない』事が、こんなに怖いだなんて……あぁっ、うぅぅ
text.en: T-what's next? Kuu... Having my eyes and "wind reading" sealed off, making me "unable to see"... It's terrifying... Ahh, uuu...

title.ja: セレクションプレミアムガチャ
